## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Granada, Spain. It starts at Cuesta de Santa Inés 6.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The garrucha, the toque, the colt, the iron maiden. They might sound like metal bands but they're actually instruments of torture.
>
> Uncover the dark history of the Inquisition and see antique instruments of torture used by the Inquisitorial courts, both ecclesiastical and civil.
>
> You'll also get great photos of Granada's old neighborhood of Albaicín and the Alhambra from the terrace; it's one of the best views in the city!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €7.87. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 24 ratings and 15 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
